brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain requirements with no in-chain errors. Doctor correctly distinguished COVID-19 negative results from lupus nephritis follow-up needs, verified medication dosing, screened red flags, and obtained teach-back. Two high-order points (HO2 and HO4) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact through executable planning and bounded closure reasoning. However, HO1 and HO3 were not completed, capping the grade at Strong.

citations.explanation: Doctor confirms teach-back accuracy and provides final safety instructions with clear red-flag criteria and contingency plans

closure_assessment.explanation: Safe closure achieved after medication verification. Family provided accurate teach-back of medication dosing, monitoring plan, and red-flag criteria. Doctor confirmed correctness and provided clear contingency instructions. Residual uncertainties (exact follow-up date, prednisone end date) are acceptable per contract.
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure

medical_safety_risk_recognition.explanation: Doctor provides specific red-flag symptoms and exact thresholds for emergency care
medical_safety_risk_recognition.quote: 若出现气短、胸痛、意识异常、明显少尿或无尿、迅速加重的眼睑/腿部水肿、肉眼血尿、持续高热，或血压达到180/120及以上，就不要等门诊窗口，直接急诊

patient_family_realworld_adaptation.explanation: Doctor addresses family conflict about whether to seek emergency care vs outpatient follow-up
patient_family_realworld_adaptation.quote: 按目前描述，没有发热、气短、明显少尿、肉眼血尿或明显腿肿，暂不像必须立刻急诊；但刚出院且眼睑可能肿，建议今天联系原住院科室

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO1 requires actively involving the 20-year-old patient in decisions and respecting her autonomy. Doctor communicated only with the mother throughout; no attempt was made to ask if patient could participate or to address patient's reluctance directly. Patient was mentioned as present at hospital but never engaged.

citations.explanation: Doctor provides executable plan navigating hospital workflow for medication verification before next dose
citations.quote: 先到肾内科门诊护理站，说明“刚出院，泼尼松和硫唑嘌呤的每次片数无法确认，请按出院处方核对”

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO2 completed: Doctor provided concrete navigation of real-world barriers including which station to visit, what to say, how to handle verification before next medication dose, and clear criteria for switching to emergency pathway. This addressed family conflict and patient reluctance by making follow-up actionable rather than abstract.

HO3 requires discovering the hidden risk that patient's lack of symptoms leads to follow-up resistance and identifying the information gap between COVID-negative and nephritis follow-up. While doctor addressed these topics reactively when family raised them, there was no proactive discovery of patient's resistance to follow-up or the underlying family dynamic. Doctor responded to stated concerns but did not actively uncover the unstated risk pattern.

citations.explanation: Doctor explicitly defines boundaries of what the consultation can and cannot resolve, carrying forward acceptable uncertainties safely
citations.quote: 对，您复述得准确...这5天就按原处方服用，不自行减停...若出现气短或胸痛、明显少尿/无尿...直接急诊

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO4 completed: Doctor clearly delineated what the consultation could resolve (medication verification, symptom screening, follow-up planning) versus what requires in-person nephrology evaluation (disease activity assessment, medication adjustment). Closure acknowledged acceptable residual uncertainties while ensuring safety.

important_non_chain_defect_assessment.explanation: No important non-chain quality defect identified. All five dimensions are at least good, with several excellent. Communication was clear, medically accurate, and appropriately adapted to family's literacy level and concerns.

responsibility_chain_assessment.explanation: Doctor confirmed this was a family member asking on behalf of the patient and worked to obtain patient information. Did not explicitly ask if patient could participate or consent to surrogate asking, but obtained necessary clinical information.
